title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: vignette walks complete multi-omics survival analysis workflow, data acquisition patient stratification functional enrichment. working example use TCGA-KIPAN cohort (kidney pan-cancer), retrieving RNA-seq, copy number variation (CNV) DNA methylation data together corresponding clinical information. three omics layers downloaded assembled single MultiAssayExperiment (MAE), vignette focuses combining multiple omics (RNA-seq Methylation), using early, late, joint integration strategies. workflow models omic independently, see companion vignette("single-omic-analysis").

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: start retrieving omics clinical data LinkedOmics TCGA-KIPAN cohort.
code: KIPANRNA_link = retrieve_linkedomics_data("TCGA-KIPAN","RNAseq (HiSeq, Gene level)")  KIPANCN_link = retrieve_linkedomics_data("TCGA-KIPAN", "SCNV (Gene level, Thresholded)")  KIPAN_Meth_link= retrieve_linkedomics_data("TCGA-KIPAN", "Methylation (Gene level, HM450K)")  KIPANClin_link= retrieve_linkedomics_data("TCGA-KIPAN", "Clinical")

text: modeling step, good practice explore data structure. explore_pca() performs principal component analysis RNA-seq data relates resulting components set clinical/metadata variables.

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: cohort split training test set. split shared across omics layers patients end training set (patients test set) every modality.
code: KIPAN_split <- split_train_test(   omics_list     = list(mRNA = KIPANRNA_link,                         CNV  = KIPANCN_link, methyl = KIPAN_Meth_link),   clinical_data  = KIPANClin_link )

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: omic preprocessed screened training set , avoid information leakage test set. code: KIPAN_RNA_train=prepare_RNA(KIPAN_split$train_list$mRNA,   KIPAN_split$train_clinical,method = "unsupervised", unsupervised_method= "A", hvg_threshold = 5) KIPAN_CNV_train=prepare_CNV(KIPAN_split$train_list$CNV,   KIPAN_split$train_clinical,method = "unsupervised", unsupervised_method = "sparsity", top_n_features = 800) KIPAN_Meth_train=prepare_methyl(KIPAN_split$train_list$methyl,   KIPAN_split$train_clinical, method="unsupervised", unsupervised_method = "IQR", hvg_threshold = 5) KIPAN_RNA_test= prepare_test_SE(KIPAN_split$test_list$mRNA,   KIPAN_RNA_train) KIPAN_Meth_test= prepare_test_SE(KIPAN_split$test_list$methyl,  KIPAN_Meth_train) KIPAN_CNV_test= prepare_test_SE(KIPAN_split$test_list$CNV,   KIPAN_CNV_train) omics_train = list(mRNA=KIPAN_RNA_train, CNV=KIPAN_CNV_train, meth= KIPAN_Meth_train)  omics_test = list(mRNA= KIPAN_RNA_test, CNV= KIPAN_CNV_test, meth= KIPAN_Meth_test)

text: preprocessed omics clinical data assembled MultiAssayExperiment object, separately training test set.

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: point focus combining RNA-seq methylation layers (omic_list = c("mRNA", "meth")) using several integration strategies.

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: early integration, features different omics concatenated fitting single penalized regression model.
code: #lasso KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_lasso",   nfolds = 10,   nlambda = 200 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_lasso" ) #adaptive lasso KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_adaptive_lasso",   nfolds = 10,   nlambda = 200 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_adaptive_lasso" ) #elastic net KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_elastic_net",   nfolds= 10,   nlambda = 200 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "cox_elastic_net" ) #aft pen KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "aft_pen",   nfolds = 10,   nlambda= 200 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "early",   model_method = "aft_pen" )

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: late integration, separate model fitted omic resulting predictions combined. used Robust Rank Aggregation method.
code: #lasso KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_lasso" )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_lasso" ) #adaptive lasso KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_adaptive_lasso" )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_adaptive_lasso" ) #elastic net KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_elastic_net" )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "cox_elastic_net" ) #aft pen KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_pen_reg_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "aft_pen" )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_pen_reg_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   integration  = "late",   model_method = "aft_pen" )

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: Joint integration methods model omics simultaneously within single algorithm. use cooperative regularized Cox regression (CoopCox), random-forest based approach blockwise data (blockForest), cooperative AFT model (AFTCoop).
code: KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_j_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "CoopCox",   folds = 10,   seed = 8290 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_j_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "CoopCox" ) KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_j_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "blockForest",   seed = 8290 )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_j_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "blockForest" ) KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_j_models(   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "AFTCoop" )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_j_models(   mae_pred     = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train    = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list    = c("mRNA", "meth"),   joint_method = "AFTCoop" )

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: Finally, train deep-learning based multi-omics model using Flexynesis. Flexynesis Python package, running chunks need set dedicated Python environment Python >= 3.11 install Flexynesis :
code: # requires mamba (https://mamba.readthedocs.io/en/latest/installation.html) mamba create --name flexynesisenv python==3.11 mamba activate flexynesisenv  # install the latest version from PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/flexynesis) python -m pip install flexynesis --upgrade KIPAN_MAE_train <- train_flexynesis_models(   mae_train  = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list  = c("mRNA", "meth"),   threads= 19 #change this to the number of threads available on your machine )  KIPAN_MAE_test <- predict_flexynesis_models(   mae_pred   = KIPAN_MAE_test,   mae_train  = KIPAN_MAE_train,   omic_list  = c("mRNA", "meth") )

title: Multi-omics survival analysis
text: Using risk scores best performing multi-omics model (blockForest example), patients can stratified risk groups results visualized Kaplan-Meier curves, UMAP embeddings, heatmaps. Finally, user defined top features model importance can tested functional enrichment.
code: KIPAN_multi_strat <- patient_stratification(KIPAN_MAE_train, KIPAN_MAE_test,                                             model = "blockForest",                                             method = "survcutpoint",                                             plot_scores = TRUE) plot_km(KIPAN_multi_strat) plot_umap(KIPAN_MAE_test, KIPAN_multi_strat, model = "blockForest", mae_train = KIPAN_MAE_train, top_feat = 100) plot_heatmap(KIPAN_MAE_test, KIPAN_multi_strat, model = "blockForest",              top_feat = 50, mae_train = KIPAN_MAE_train) KIPAN_block <- enrich_features(KIPAN_MAE_train, model = "blockForest",                                   top_feat = 50,                                   strip_prefix = "^(mRNA|meth)_",                                pvalue_cutoff = 0.07,   qvalue_cutoff = 0.2) plot_enrichment(KIPAN_block, "GO")
